description: Find agentPickup shops to order from: near a point (lat/lng), in a suburb or city (place), or selling something (query). Returns each shop's shop_url, pickup address, hours, whether it's open now, distance, and matching menu items.

lat.description: Where the user is: latitude. Send with lng.

lng.description: Where the user is: longitude. Send with lat.

open_now.description: Only shops open now (shops without listed hours stay in).

place.description: A suburb, street or city to match against shop addresses, e.g. "Surry Hills".

query.description: What the user wants, e.g. "AA batteries", "flowers" or "sourdough". Leave out to list everything.

radius_km.description: With lat/lng: how far to look. Default 10.

name: find_shops
title: Find pickup shops
